groundRule: a ground tile is exactly ppt x ppt px (the scene's depth is stretched by 1/sin(35)); heights show at ppt*cos(35) px per tile

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

door-boss-a.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
door-boss-a.note: SAMPLE look A (closed door only). 160 px wide: the door cell plus half a tile of wall each side; anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell
